item.title: IndiGo names new Operations Control Centre head to steady flights post-December disruption
item.description: According to an internal communication, the airline has appointed Rohit Rikhye has been appointed as the Head of OCC with immediate effect. He will report to Chief Operating Officer Isidre Porqueras.

item.title: Who is Sophie Shine? The Irish banking executive who married Shikhar Dhawan
item.description: Sophie studied Marketing and Management at the Limerick Institute of Technology between 2012 and 2016.

item.title: 'Seems hard to rely on': Top lawyer behind SC blow questions Trump's 15% tariff authority again
item.description: Trump said on Saturday raised tariffs from 10 per cent to 15 per cent using a different statutory route

item.title: Fake Aadhaar, foreign handlers: Terror plot busted, 8 arrested in Bengal, Tamil Nadu
item.description: Police sources said some of those arrested are Bangladeshi nationals who were allegedly using fake Aadhaar cards to hide their identities.

item.title: Dip buyers have vanished: Bitcoin falls 40% from peak, its biggest support suddenly missing
item.description: US-listed gold ETFs drew more than $16 billion in the past three months, while spot Bitcoin ETFs saw roughly $3.3 billion in outflows, according to Bloomberg-compiled data

item.title: After court blow, Trump trains fire on India-linked firms; MAGA circles target Xbox CEO
item.description: Trump attacked the plaintiffs in the case, including Chicago-based Learning Resources, a small family-owned toy company that imports educational toys, STEM kits, and classroom supplies from India

item.title: 'It takes a lot of energy to train a human too': OpenAI's Sam Altman counters AI power criticism
item.description: The fair comparison is if you ask ChatGPT a question, how much energy does it take once its model is trained to answer that question versus a human? says Sam Altman

item.title: 'Nothing wrong with 15%': Samir Arora explains why Trump's tariff may not hurt India
item.description: Donald Trump on Saturday hiked a global tariff to 15 per cent, up from the 10 per cent rate imposed a day earlier, after the US Supreme Court struck down his earlier tariffs

item.title: IDFC First Bank detects Rs 590 crore fraud linked to Haryana govt accounts, suspends four officials
item.description: The matter is confined to a specific group of government-linked accounts within the Haryana Government operated through the said branch in Chandigarh and does not extend to other customers, says IDFC First Bank
